name: aurum-eleven-video
description: Remotion compositions rendering the Aurum Eleven hero loop and the line-up film for the website.

scripts.master:smooth: ffmpeg -y -i public/showreel.mp4 -vf "minterpolate=fps=75:mi_mode=mci:mc_mode=aobmc:me_mode=bidir:vsbmc=1" -c:v libx264 -crf 12 -preset medium -pix_fmt yuv420p -an public/showreel-75.mp4
scripts.render:stage: remotion render StageSource out/a11-stage-source.mp4 --codec=h264 --crf=25 && remotion render StageSourceSmall out/a11-stage-source-sm.mp4 --codec=h264 --crf=26
scripts.render:fallback: remotion render HeroStage out/a11-hero-stage.mp4 --codec=h264 --crf=26 && remotion render HeroMobile out/a11-hero-mobile.mp4 --codec=h264 --crf=26
scripts.render:posters: remotion still HeroStage out/a11-hero-stage.jpg --frame=40 --image-format=jpeg && remotion still HeroMobile out/a11-hero-mobile.jpg --frame=40 --image-format=jpeg && remotion still LineUp out/a11-sklad-poster.jpg --frame=150 --image-format=jpeg
scripts.render: npm run render:stage && npm run render:fallback && npm run render:lineup && npm run render:posters
